from collections import deque
def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # anchor cells: 3-cells fully enclosed inside the 3-rectangle frame (not on frame border)
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if 3 in r]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if any(r[j]==3 for r in g)]
    top,left=min(rows),min(cols); bot,right=max(rows),max(cols)
    anchors=[(i,j) for i in range(top+1,bot) for j in range(left+1,right) if g[i][j]==3]
    D={}
    dq=deque()
    for a in anchors:
        D[a]=0; dq.append(a)
    while dq:
        i,j=dq.popleft()
        for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            ni,nj=i+di,j+dj
            if 0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w and g[ni][nj]!=3 and (ni,nj) not in D:
                D[(ni,nj)]=D[(i,j)]+1
                if D[(ni,nj)]%2==1: out[ni][nj]=4
                else: out[ni][nj]=2
                dq.append((ni,nj))
    return out
